title: 第22章 又遇柳嫣然第23章 暗幽魔狼
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
叶辰，仔细的探查一番后，没有发现有价值的东西。带着小墨继续往一座一座的山峰探寻
叶辰走着走着，突然一道身影撞了过来，后面有5人在追两人看清后
“公子”
“小雨”
两人同时惊讶到
“公子，快，快救救逸尘和梦瑶姐，我们被皇城的赵家追杀！”杜小雨急切的说着
叶辰拿出一颗精元丹递给杜小雨
“你先疗伤！这几个交给我”叶辰安慰着杜小雨
看着杜小雨凄惨的模样，叶辰怒火丛生，祭出倚天剑和雷鸣剑，以气御剑，顿时狂风骤起，电闪雷鸣，犹如两天神龙相互纠缠，相互环绕，阴阳两级相辅相成，所到之处，剑气横生，寸草不生！”
“啊！我们是赵家……”5人话还未说完，已经被千刀万剐，只剩下一地的碎尸
“敢动我的人！哼！”叶辰冷哼一声，扶着杜小雨，走我们去找秦梦瑶和逸尘。
“铿铿锵锵”
打斗声就在前面
二人急忙赶了过去，只见赵千亿手执羽扇，风轻云淡的看着他的护卫围攻秦梦瑶和秦逸尘
“梦瑶姐，逸尘你们没事吧！”叶辰急忙上前关切的看着二人
“没事，你怎么来了”
“没事，公子”
二人看着叶辰甚是激动，你们先去疗伤，给了二人各一颗精元丹叶辰走向了赵千亿
“赵千亿，几日之前你在叶府门口给我的羞辱，你今日又伤我兄弟，我们好好算算这笔账”叶辰怒目而视
“呵呵，不就是一个小小的叶家吗？本打算先解决了你，在灭了叶家，没想到今日在这碰到你，你们这群贱民，今日插翅难逃”赵千亿恶狠狠的对着叶辰说

“上，都给我上，灭了叶辰，赏金千两”
20多个护卫团团围住了四人。
“杀啊”
“杀啊”
……
嘶喊声一片
叶辰不慌不忙的祭出雷鸣剑和倚天剑，双剑齐出，电闪雷鸣，风起云涌，剑气瞬间笼罩着这20个护卫.两息之间，叶辰崔古拉休的团灭了赵家护卫，赵千亿目瞪口呆，“叶辰，你等着，他日灭了你叶家”只见赵千亿使用了一张千里遁。
“哎！皇城之人保命手段真是多啊！”
叶辰不再纠结，反正以后有的是时间收拾赵家。
叶辰回过头来看着三人“你们怎么会碰上赵家。李元霸呢？”
“李元霸在前面的炼器峰上，得到了传承，在那闭关。”秦逸尘回到
“我们与赵家乃是世仇，秦家之所以会落的现在的境况，全是拜赵家所赐！”秦逸尘目光坚定。
“我们先找个地方休息一下，你们得先疗伤”
四人找到一处隐蔽的地方，休息了一夜，连日来的奔波带来的疲惫，一扫而空。神清气爽
“你们接下来有什么计划吗？”叶辰询问道
“我们刚才商量了一下，一会去炼器峰等李元霸，他接受完传承后，我们就一起回去了，这十几天的生死磨炼已经可以了，目前修为还是有点低，再往深处全部是筑基境和金丹境强者我们去了有害无益，我们就先回去修炼”秦梦瑶说道
“那好吧！你们先回去吧，我到处在看看，资源方面你们暂时不需要考虑，我这次得了不少灵药丹药，你们主要就是好好提高修为。”
叶辰说完就告别了三人，继续探险
走了两天两夜，走到了一处僻静的幽谷，鸟语花香，一潭清水，叶辰当即褪去衣物，眼见四下无人，又如此僻静，下到水里畅游一番
游着游着.来到了潭水中央

“啊！”一声尖叫响起。
叶辰定眼一看
“嫣然，怎么是你”
嫣然再次尖叫了一声，羞红了脸，叶辰此时反应过来了，尴尬无比
“叶辰，你还看，转过身去”嫣然娇滴滴的说着
content_en:
Ye Chen, after careful exploration, found nothing of value. Take Xiao Mo and continue to explore the peaks one by one.
Ye Chen was walking when suddenly a figure bumped into him. There were five people chasing him after they saw clearly.
"Master"
"light rain"
Both of them were surprised at the same time
"Sir, hurry up, save Yichen and Sister Mengyao, we are being hunted by the Zhao family in the imperial city!" Du Xiaoyu said eagerly
Ye Chen took out a Jingyuan Pill and handed it to Du Xiaoyu
"Heal your wounds first! Leave these to me" Ye Chen comforted Du Xiaoyu
Seeing Du Xiaoyu's miserable appearance, Ye Chen was filled with anger. He sacrificed the Yitian Sword and the Thunder Sword, and used Qi to control the swords. Suddenly, strong winds rose, lightning flashed and thunder, like two divine dragons entangled and surrounding each other, with Yin and Yang complementing each other. Wherever the sword Qi went, there was no grass growing! "
"ah! We are the Zhao family..." Before the five people could finish speaking, they had been cut into pieces with thousands of knives, leaving only broken corpses on the ground.
"Dare to touch my people! snort! "Ye Chen snorted coldly, supported Du Xiaoyu, and walked us to find Qin Mengyao and Yichen.
"Clang clang clang clang"
The sound of fighting is just ahead
The two hurried over and saw Zhao Qianyi holding a feather fan in his hand, watching his guards besieging Qin Mengyao and Qin Yichen calmly.
"Sister Mengyao, Yichen, are you okay? "Ye Chen hurriedly stepped forward and looked at the two of them with concern.
"It's okay, why are you here?"
"It's okay, sir"
The two of them were very excited when they saw Ye Chen. You go to heal your wounds first and gave each of them a Jingyuan Pill. Ye Chen walked towards Zhao Qianyi.
"Zhao Qianyi, you humiliated me at the gate of Ye Mansion a few days ago, and you hurt my brother again today. Let's settle the score carefully." Ye Chen glared at
"Haha, isn't it just a small Ye family? I planned to deal with you first and then destroy the Ye family, but I didn’t expect to meet you here today. You guys are untouchables and you can’t escape today.” Zhao Qianyi said fiercely to Ye Chen.
"Come on, come on, come on, kill Ye Chen, and I'll get a reward of a thousand taels."
More than 20 guards surrounded the four people.
"Kill"
"Kill"
…
A lot of screaming
Ye Chen calmly took out the Thunder Sword and the Yitian Sword. The two swords came out together, lightning flashed, thunder and wind surged, and the sword energy instantly enveloped the 20 guards. In two breaths, Ye Chen's group of Cui Gu Laxiu destroyed the Zhao family guards. Zhao Qianyi was stunned, "Ye Chen, wait, I will destroy your Ye family one day." Zhao Qianyi used Thousand Miles Escape.
"Hey! There are so many ways for people in the imperial city to save their lives! "
Ye Chen no longer hesitates, since he will have plenty of time to clean up the Zhao family in the future.
Ye Chen turned back and looked at the three of them, "Why did you meet the Zhao family? Where is Li Yuanba? "
"Li Yuanba received the inheritance on the Weapon Refining Peak in front and retreated there. "Qin Yichen returned
"We have a feud with the Zhao family, and the reason why the Qin family is in the current situation is all thanks to the Zhao family! "Qin Yichen's eyes were firm.
"Let's find a place to rest first. You have to heal your injuries first."
The four of them found a secluded place and rested for the night. The fatigue caused by running around in the past few days was gone. Refreshed
"What are your plans next? "Ye Chen asked
"We just discussed that we will go to the Refining Peak to wait for Li Yuanba. After he has accepted the inheritance, we will go back together. The past ten days of life and death training are enough, and the current cultivation level is still a bit low. Going deeper are all the strong ones in the Foundation Establishment Realm and the Golden Core Realm. If we go there, it will be harmful and useless, so we will go back to practice first," Qin Mengyao said
"Okay then! You guys should go back first. I'm looking around. You don't need to think about resources for the time being. I got a lot of elixirs and pills this time. The main thing for you is to improve your cultivation. "
After Ye Chen said goodbye to the three of them, he continued his adventure.
After walking for two days and two nights, he came to a secluded valley, with birds singing and flowers smelling, and a pool of clear water. Ye Chen immediately took off his clothes and saw no one around. It was so quiet, so he went down to the water to take a dip.
Swim aroundThen we came to the middle of the pond
"Ah!" A scream sounded.
Ye Chen took a closer look
"Yanran, why is it you?"
Yanran screamed again and blushed with embarrassment. Ye Chen realized it at this time and was extremely embarrassed.
"Ye Chen, if you still look, turn around," Yanran said sweetly.
